column3: “Raised you up” is rendered “exalted you,” and “ruler” as “leader.”
“Sweep away after Baasha” is rendered “consume Baasha.”
“The scroll of the matters of the days” is rendered “the Book of the Chronicles.”
NASB supplies “both because of”; “he struck it” keeps the ambiguous Hebrew.
“One who urinates on a wall” is rendered “a single male,” and “kinsman redeemer” as “relatives.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “Therefore.”
“Into the half” is rendered “into two parts,” and “behind” as “followed.”
“Built the hill” is rendered “built on the hill.”
“Did evil more than” is rendered “acted more wickedly than.”
The Hebrew reads “his sin”; NASB has “his sins” (reading tradition). “Vanities” is rendered “idols.”
